{
  "title": "Strike Lab: 1-Player Training Arena",
  "summary": "Strike Lab is a clean, responsive single-player fighting game training arena designed for desktop and touch. Upon spawning in a minimalist indoor dojo/lab ring, the player approaches an interactive humanoid training dummy. Pressing or tapping the strike input initiates a deterministic 3-hit light-attack sequence (Jab -> Cross -> Hook) with distinct windup, active contact, and recovery animation phases. The server strictly validates attack range (under 6.5 studs) and contact timing windows to prevent button-holding or recovery spam exploits. On verified hit, dummy health decreases, the active combo hit counter increments, distinct impact audio plays, and hit sparks appear. On miss or out-of-range swings, a light whoosh sound and miss indicator trigger with zero damage and no combo increment. When the dummy is defeated (0 HP), it ragdolls/dissolves and automatically resets after a short delay, with an explicit manual Reset Dummy button always available on the HUD. Touch controls provide dedicated on-screen strike and reset buttons alongside desktop keyboard/mouse input.",
  "visualDirection": "A modern, high-contrast training dojo / martial arts laboratory. Clean floor grid with distinct ring boundaries marked by neon floor lines. A dedicated central training platform hosts the humanoid sparring dummy. Clean, readable HUD with crisp combo counter styling, dummy health bar with damage lag indicator, attack phase indicator (Windup/Active/Recovery), and mobile-friendly touch action buttons. Particle effects include sharp directional impact sparks for clean hits and subtle air streaks for misses.",
  "assetStrategy": "Search Marketplace first for reusable fighting dummy rigs, punch/strike animation packs, and verified combat sound effects (punches, whooshes, resets). If Marketplace rig/animation components require custom glue, author the server-side strike arbiter and client presentation layers while referencing the imported assets.",
